newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's shares little changed in the week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's shares little changed in the week.

text.p: Shares on the Bahrain stock exchange spent last week in a narrow range, with the index ending little changed, the bourse said.
The index dipped to 1,547.89 points in the week to Thursday from 1,549.85 points the previous week.
Trade rose to five million shares worth 1.4 million dinars ($3.7 million) from 4.3 million shares worth 1.2 million dinars.
Shares of 22 firms out of 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 134 transactions.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
